crossRefs.note: Yet you may eat these: of all winged creeping things that go on all fours, which have long, jointed legs for hopping on…

parallels.note: All winged creeping things are unclean to you. They shall not be eaten.

translations.web: Yet you may eat these: of all winged creeping things that go on all fours, which have long, jointed legs for hopping on the earth.
translations.bsb: However, you may eat the following kinds of flying insects that walk on all fours: those having jointed legs above their feet for hopping on the ground.
translations.kjv: Yet these may ye eat of every flying creeping thing that goeth upon all four, which have legs above their feet, to leap withal upon the earth;
translations.asv: Yet these may ye eat of all winged creeping things that go upon all fours, which have legs above their feet, wherewith to leap upon the earth.
